title: ChromaDB anonymized telemetry is on
explanation: chromadb sends anonymized telemetry (PostHog) by default. It's off only when ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY is False in the environment or anonymized_telemetry=False is passed in client Settings.

evidence.detail: chromadb 0.5.23 installed; not disabled in the image (none of ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=0|false|no|off)

fix: Set ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=False in the image environment.
